summary: Where each package belongs and why. Pick a row to see its purpose, where new code goes, what it imports and what imports it. Dependency numbers are read live from the source; descriptions are dated to the audit.

rules.title: Imports point down the layers
rules.detail: entry > app > domain > platform > foundation. Nothing imports internal/cli. The app packages (hooks, launch, configure) are imported only from cli or each other's narrow helpers.

rules.title: Foundation stays stdlib-only
rules.detail: paths, proc, textutil, models, ui/ansi, secrets/shapes, buildver have no internal imports. Anything added here must keep that true. schemas (imports only paths) and audit sit just above.

rules.title: Never import a heavy package for a constant
rules.detail: If you need one path, name, header or lock from a big package, move that symbol down to a leaf instead. This is the main source of false height in the graph today.

rules.title: Nesting means a dependency of its parent
rules.detail: CLAUDE.md rule: a package more than one area imports stays top-level (router, ledger); a helper only one area uses nests under it (agent/tools). A directory is a namespace, not a layer. Before nesting or moving, run Import check.

rules.title: External SDKs are boxed in one package
rules.detail: CLAUDE.md rule. anthropicsdk and copilotsdk are the boxes; a third-party import outside its box is a finding. bbolt and mdsmith are unboxed libraries today.

rules.title: Break a cycle by moving code down, not by injecting
rules.detail: First extract the shared piece to a lower package. Injection is only for a true inversion (a low package must call a high one), and then as an explicit field on an options struct passed by the caller. No cross-package assignment from init().

rules.title: cli parses, engines work
rules.detail: internal/cli holds the verb table and flag handling; engines take typed options and return values. A verb file over 300 lines usually holds an engine. Exceptions today: databricks.Run, clean.Run and review/* own their own flag parsing.

rules.title: *test packages are test-only
rules.detail: hosttest, pathstest and vaulttest are imported only from _test.go files, so their importer count reads 0 in production imports.

cmd.notHere: Anything else; there is only one binary.

defaults.purpose: Embeds the shipped default settings files.

defaults/claude.purpose: settings.json source of truth (hard rule 1); make install renders ~/.claude/settings.json from it.

internal.purpose: All Go packages of the binary.

internal/paths.purpose: Locates the config dir and state dirs; atomic and locked file writes; repo slug.
internal/paths.addHere: A location several packages need, including vendor homes (CODEX_HOME). Atomic file helpers.

internal/paths/pathstest.purpose: Isolated fake vendor executables for tests.

internal/proc.purpose: Process plumbing: liveness, detach, start time, env scrubbing, git env, WSL detection.
internal/proc.addHere: OS process primitives with per-platform files.
internal/proc.notHere: Anything knowing about providers or agents.

internal/proc/inflight.purpose: Agent-inflight markers shared by the hook, the status line and agents reap; plus provider concurrency caps.
internal/proc/inflight.notHere: Provider or quota logic; caps.go is the only reason this sits at L6.

internal/textutil.addHere: Small pure string helpers, including the shared shell-quote.

internal/models.purpose: Parses Claude model ids and derives per-model knobs (1M context, thinking, effort names).
internal/models.notHere: Which model to pick (router) or a provider's list (providers).

internal/schemas.purpose: Registry of versioned on-disk and wire formats; owners register their own rows.
internal/schemas.addHere: A new file format row (change protocol step 5).
internal/schemas.notHere: Format parsers; those stay with their owner.

internal/audit.purpose: Typed action log with no credential exposure; read by doctor --audit.

internal/completion.purpose: Renders and installs the bash completion script. Candidates live in cli/complete*.go.

internal/ui.purpose: Namespace for terminal output. Members span L0 to L7, so it does not imply a layer.

internal/ui/ansi.purpose: SGR escapes in truecolor, 256 and 16-colour modes; TTY check.

internal/ui/theme.purpose: Applies the tracked theme/ directory to each tool's config.

internal/ui/helptext.purpose: One flag-parsing and help-page format for every verb; --format handling.

internal/ui/tui.purpose: Raw-terminal pickers, confirm and secret prompts.
internal/ui/tui.notHere: Engine code should not call this directly; pass a callback.

internal/ui/statusline.purpose: Renders Claude Code's status line in five styles from its JSON payload.
internal/ui/statusline.notHere: Quota or provider logic. Reads proxy state and providers, so it is an app feature, not a UI primitive.

internal/vault.purpose: Encrypted bbolt store: sealed secrets, pins, env, overlays; master-key resolution.

internal/vault/vaulttest.purpose: Throwaway vault for tests. Missing a package doc.

internal/secrets.purpose: Secret surface: store and lookup, plus read-only audits (scan, git history, doctor).
internal/secrets.notHere: Provider logic. network/* needs only secrets.Get yet inherits providers through this package.

internal/secrets/shapes.purpose: The one credential-shape heuristic for printers and scanners.
internal/secrets/shapes.addHere: New token shapes (the Slack matcher dup belongs here).

internal/settings.purpose: Renders settings.json and merges it into an existing one; hook declarations (hookspec.go).

internal/providers.purpose: Model-routing registry: upstreams, wire dialects, credential sources, tier pins; defaults.json.
internal/providers.addHere: A provider field or auth type.
internal/providers.notHere: The pick among providers (router) or the HTTP path (proxy).

internal/translate.purpose: Converts between Anthropic Messages and OpenAI chat completions.

internal/anthropicsdk.purpose: Boxes anthropic-sdk-go: one streaming Messages call, stdlib types out.

internal/copilotsdk.purpose: Boxes copilot-sdk: one headless turn plus catalog listing.
internal/copilotsdk.addHere: The direct SDK use in agent/copilot_registry.go.

internal/router.purpose: Agent+model pick: route table, candidate gates, BYOK pool, served cache, per-account quota state.
internal/router.notHere: HTTP forwarding (proxy) or running the agent (agent). Stays top-level: nine packages import it.

internal/proxy.purpose: Loopback HTTP proxy Claude Code talks to: translation, cross-provider slots, failover, usage ledger writes.
internal/proxy.notHere: Client-side helpers; those force memory and statusline to import the server.

internal/agent.purpose: One headless task on any agent CLI under one retry loop. In practice also: launchers, config renderers, jobs, dispatch log, review, explore, transfer, live sessions, sign-in, roster.
internal/agent.addHere: Behaviour every agent shares, at the retry loop. Vendor quirks in the vendor's file.
internal/agent.notHere: Paths, tokens or names other packages need (paths); verb parsing (cli); prompts (cli callback).

internal/agent/template.purpose: Embedded templates for agent config renders.

internal/agent/project.purpose: Projects agents/ into each agent's subagent dir, links skills, renders global instruction files. Imported by agent.

internal/agent/preflight.purpose: Per-agent pin check and post-install pong round. Missing a package doc.

internal/agent/tools.purpose: Installs and updates agent CLIs into ~/.claude/bin.

internal/agent/tree.purpose: Live tree of sessions, subagents and dispatches; reap; the view behind agents tree, network view and the page. Missing a package doc.

internal/memory.purpose: Per-repo and home memory banks: blocks, recall, embeddings, update, dream, promote, native MEMORY.md.
internal/memory.notHere: Store paths and the bank lock, which four packages need and should get from a leaf.

internal/memory/prompts.purpose: Embedded prompts for update and dream runs.

internal/memory/templates.purpose: Embedded bank file templates used by memory init.

internal/transcript.purpose: Reads Claude Code session JSONL: context size, files written.

internal/usage.purpose: Token totals, peak rate, per-agent stores, live plan quotas, workflow rollups.
internal/usage.notHere: Ledger writes (internal/tokenledger, kept light for the proxy).

internal/tokenledger.purpose: Per-token ledger the proxy appends to and usage reads.
internal/tokenledger.notHere: Imports heavier than paths and schemas.

internal/plans.purpose: Parses plan checklists; ticks, claims, status.
internal/plans.notHere: Plan linting (review/planlint), a different thing with nearly the same name.

internal/history.purpose: Shadow git history of config files.
internal/history.notHere: Memory history. Imports agent for one path.

internal/clean.purpose: The state sweep behind claude-code clean. Owns its own flags.

internal/worktree.purpose: Lifecycle of ~/worktrees/<repo>/<name>: create, classify, verified merge, ledger.

internal/network.purpose: Namespace for things that reach past this machine. Members span L1 to L10.

internal/network/browser.purpose: Detects browser control paths (extension host, CDP, WebDriver) and scrapes pages.
internal/network/browser.notHere: Internal imports beyond paths; it is correctly low.

internal/network/mcp.purpose: Read-only MCP config and health diagnostic, plus the stdio web-search server.

internal/network/tailscale.purpose: Tailscale admin API, tailscale CLI, remote ssh runner.
internal/network/tailscale.notHere: Generic shell quoting and host validation; agent imports this package only for those.

internal/network/vscode.purpose: Merges VS Code settings templates; serves code serve-web on the tailnet; links the extension.
internal/network/vscode.notHere: Note it is both a local config merge and a network server.

internal/network/web.purpose: The network page dashboard: agents, plans, usage, this page.
internal/network/web.addHere: A dashboard tab and its endpoint.
internal/network/web.notHere: Engines. Imports agent only for DispatchDir.

internal/network/web/assets.purpose: Embedded page template and this audit's content.

internal/network/web/assets/usage.purpose: go:generate copies of vscode/claude-code-agents/lib modules. Edit the originals.

internal/databricks.purpose: Launches Claude Code on Databricks serving; login, mint, import/export, smoke checks. Owns its own verb tree.

internal/databricks/oauth.purpose: Stdlib-only token mint: U2M PKCE, refresh, M2M. providers imports it directly.

internal/databricks/templates.purpose: Embedded claude and codex config templates.

internal/desktop.purpose: Claude Desktop gateway profile with no embedded credentials.

internal/clipboard.purpose: WSL image paste workaround, wl-paste proxy, macOS launchd bridge.

internal/review.purpose: Namespace for deterministic detectors (source, diff, planlint).

internal/testtool.purpose: Namespace for test tooling (mutate, ramdisk) that the test verb exposes.

internal/review/source.purpose: Quality and complexity detectors over source files; review-simplicity hook input.

internal/review/diff.purpose: Diff surgeon, PR analysis, report generation, advisory gate.

internal/review/planlint.purpose: Plan linters (assumptions, goals), workflow skeleton and lint.

internal/testtool/mutate.purpose: Mutation check via go -overlay, behind claude-code test mutate.
internal/testtool/mutate.addHere: Test tooling behind the test verb.

internal/testtool/ramdisk.purpose: Runs a command with TMPDIR on an APFS RAM disk, behind claude-code test ramdisk.
internal/testtool/ramdisk.addHere: Test tooling behind the test verb.

internal/hooks.purpose: Lifecycle hook handlers: safety gate, dispatch effort, memory, docs placement, format, worktree.
internal/hooks.addHere: A hook handler; declare it in settings/hookspec.go.
internal/hooks.notHere: Shared logic other packages import. launch imports this for one binary path.

internal/launch.purpose: Misnamed: install steps, doctor checks, settings drift, tmux config. Launching itself is agent/launch_*.go.

internal/setup.purpose: adopt, nuke and workspace modes behind install --setup. Its doc still names a removed setup verb.

internal/configure.purpose: The guided setup TUI: pages for provider, models, agents, routing, GitHub and more.
internal/configure.notHere: Writes other verbs also perform; call the owner.

internal/cli.purpose: Verb table, help, completion spec and verb handlers. Imports 49 packages by design.
internal/cli.addHere: A verb's flag parsing and printing.
internal/cli.notHere: Engines. vault_table.go, providers.go, memory.go and agent.go have outgrown handlers.

internal/hosttest.purpose: Gives each test binary a clean host: no agent CLIs, no credentials, throwaway HOME.

agents.purpose: Subagent definitions, flat; name: must equal the file stem. Projected into other agents' homes.
agents.addHere: A new subagent (change protocol: manifest first).

commands.purpose: Slash commands, flat; thin launchers into an agent or skill.

workflows.purpose: Saved Workflow tool scripts: code-agent, code-analyzer, code-engineer, green-keeper-loop.

rules.purpose: Rule files loaded by scope; contract in rules/README.md.

rules/standards.purpose: Always-on rules. Every line costs every session.

rules/workflow.purpose: Agent and memory workflow rules; needs paths: scoping.

rules/harness.purpose: Rules for working on the harness itself; needs paths: scoping.

skills.purpose: On-demand references. Untracked dirs are the user's own symlinks; synced/ is re-downloaded from claude.ai.
skills.addHere: A tracked skill, after a license check.

skills/evaluate-code.purpose: Audit, review and security lenses; wraps claude-code review.

skills/problem-solving.purpose: The evidence loop for a task, fix or plan.

skills/subagent-workflows.purpose: Choosing and running multi-agent work; handoff contract.

skills/web-search.purpose: Tavily search fallback through network websearch.

skills/evaluate-code/references.purpose: Lens checklists the skill loads on demand.

skills/problem-solving/references.purpose: Mode references for the evidence loop.

docs.purpose: Only images/ and templates/ are allowed here (docs-placement gate).

docs/images.purpose: README images, including the help-svg output.

docs/templates.purpose: Golden examples of rendered settings and memory.

docs/templates/examples/settings.purpose: Golden settings example; regenerated with hook changes.

theme.purpose: One JSON per tool; applied by theme apply.

vscode/claude-code-agents/lib.purpose: Shared usage modules; the source for web/assets/usage.
vscode/claude-code-agents/lib.addHere: Usage rendering; then go generate in internal/network/web.

.github.purpose: CI workflows, dependabot, issue and PR templates, SECURITY.md.

.githooks.purpose: Tracked git hooks; pre-push runs make audit.

opus.note: Launches Claude on the alias. -h prints upstream claude help, not harness help.

fable.note: -h fails on a profile with no fable pin.

anthropic.note: Hidden but named in the menu header.

copilot.note: Same verb set as codex, gemini, opencode through AgentVerb.

codex.note: -f means config.toml here but follow on tail.

opencode.note: Menu and -h name different plans. catalog has its own sub-verbs.

databricks.note: Filed under AGENTS but it launches Claude on a provider. Owns its own parsing.

vault.note: vault_table.go holds a full table engine.

network.note: view and restart are not network verbs.

switch.note: One of three ways to pin a profile.

test.note: Verb and package tree disagree. Help mentions only mutate -h.

memory.note: Ten plumbing verbs off the menu; output still says memory doctor.

doctor.note: Mode flags pick unrelated jobs: health, audit log, secret scan.

gateway.note: Three names for one concern: gateway, router, proxy.

describe.note: Reads the completion spec, so it under-reports flags.

install.note: --setup nuke is a destructive mode behind an install flag.

theme.note: statusline is a runtime renderer filed under theme.

help-svg.note: Build tool for the README image.

ask.note: The most-used verb, hidden from the menu. --job and --stdin-framed are internal flags shown in -h.

agents.note: Hidden. status, result, tail, cancel repeat the per-agent verbs.

models.note: Hidden, but named in configure help and in errors.

review.note: Hidden. Deterministic detectors, while <agent> review is an LLM review. Uses --json, not --format.

hook.note: Hidden on purpose: settings.json runs it.
